blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: The official enclave signage tries to make Hush look managed, but the lived-in village keeps showing through the label.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: The welcome sign has been scrubbed so many times the paint underneath shows through: Hush™, A Certified Safe Community. The trademark symbol is newer than the village. Blue wayfinding arrows point toward approved gathering areas, approved scenic overlooks...

blocks.body: Local residents or workers appropriate to the place Ratcoons avoid the freshly painted visitor path Festival Moths ignore official signage Young Dryads keep to the older tree line No default combatant; add only if the scene introduces one Local civic, trade...
